two_verifiers_in_one_component.reason: Reputation averages the three votes. Dependency averages semantic with evidence first, then averages that component with rule.
two_verifiers_in_one_component.reports: semantic SUPPORT 1, evidence SUPPORT 1, rule REJECT 0.2

policy.tie_break: The solver returns one distribution. The recorded modal strategy is the maximum of (probability, strategy_id). Strategies with the same worst-case loss are optimal even when that distribution puts probability 1 on only one of them.

slices.population: full_minimax rows. The other two methods match these decisions and losses on every cell.

verifier_summary.cost_note: Recorded milliseconds are this run's wall time. Frozen means are the feasibility and penalty costs. They are different measurements.
